metaDescription: Order custom straight fit products for your team. Perfect Imprints offers bulk branding on straight fit apparel and accessories.
introHtml: Straight fit products offer a classic, relaxed silhouette that suits a wide range of body types without being too loose or too tight. Whether you are outfitting a sales team with branded polo shirts or providing uniform workwear for warehouse staff, straight fit ensures a professional look that stays comfortable throughout the day. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a polished finish.
